## Validation

- [ ] The folder name matches a unique manifest ID; entry, preview, and assets are included.
- [ ] The scene works offline with no remote scripts, fonts, or media.
- [ ] I have permission to redistribute the scene and every included asset.
- [ ] I tested it in seeWallpaper: preview, desktop, and custom settings if present.
- [ ] Pause/resume works and the animation respects Eco, Balanced, and High target FPS.
- [ ] I checked different window sizes and recorded the tested Windows version and display resolution below.
- [ ] For an update, I kept the existing ID and author and increased the version.
